Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The technical specifications:
Item | 75 ton | 150 Ton | 300 ton
Type | M10337A | N/A | 26-I 20 I 22- Π C
Mfg | Russia & USA | Russia & USA | Russia
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ashraf Saber Ibrahem, accepted by eng. Soliman Abdel-Fatah: general manager, approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
